name: Nogah
title: Son of King David
summary: Nogah was one of the sons of King David, born in Jerusalem. He is mentioned in Chronicles as part of David's royal descendants. Little is known about his life beyond his place in David's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the sons of David born in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Nogah is listed among the sons who were born to David after he became king in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: David's Royal Lineage
keyEvents.description: As part of David's descendants, Nogah represents the royal lineage established in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: David Establishes Himself in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: After David conquered Jerusalem and made it his capital, he had several sons, including Nogah.

keyEvents.title: David's Family Grows in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Nogah's birth was part of the expansion of David's royal household in the new capital, Jerusalem, as a sign of God's blessing upon the king.
